title: Yellow Fried Korean Peppers Skillet
description: A salty and snappy Korean dish featuring mixed peppers, deep-fry-tod, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in an iron teppan.

ingredients.name: mixed peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell peppers and Korean chili peppers

instructions: Heat the iron teppan over medium-high heat and add the vegetable oil.
Add the deep-fry-tod and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the deep-fry-tod from the teppan and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the teppan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mixed peppers to the teppan and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to the teppan and stir to combine.
Return the deep-fry-tod to the teppan and stir to combine with the peppers and sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the peppers are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the Yellow Fried Korean Peppers Skillet hot, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
